free_tier.stated: Per-minute GPU rental with a public price list. An aggregator that polls the vendor daily records RTX 4090D 48GB stock in Zhejiang at USD 0.194 per card-hour on a monthly rate and USD 0.238 on demand, and RTX 4090 24GB at a minimum of USD 0.231 per card-hour. The vendor page states 按量计费，部署不计费，用多少付多少 (metered by usage, deployment is not billed, you pay for what you use), quoted.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A 48 GB card at USD 0.20 an hour changes which models fit: a 32B model in 4-bit needs more than 24 GB, and this is the cheapest listed way to rent past that line.
limits_note: Nothing throttles per job. The first thing to fail is availability: the aggregator's cheapest row for this vendor is monthly-rate 4090D stock in one region, and third-party price tables note queueing at peak.

notes: Two third-party price tables disagree with the aggregator on this vendor: hcit.com.cn lists a 24 GB 4090 at CNY 1.78 an hour and datalearner lists CNY 2.37 an hour, both older.
